narrationTexts: I'll start by exploring the repository structure.
finalText:
**Migration done in app code.** 36 `db.query` calls in 12 files now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

Left alone on purpose:

| What | Why |
|---|---|
| `cache.query` in 21 files | Takes a cache key, not SQL |
| [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9) and :13 | Vendored, edits lost on upgrade |

Every module still loads under `node`.

Next: the vendor call needs an upstream fix or a wrapper. `db.query` cannot be dropped until then.
